# Українська правда

> > Independent Ukrainian news outlet featuring opinion blogs, political commentary, and war analysis by leading Ukrainian journalists and experts.

Українська правда (Ukrayinska Pravda) is a major Ukrainian online newspaper providing critical analysis of Ukrainian politics, EU integration, reforms, and the ongoing war. The site features prominent commentators including Mikhaylo Zhernakov, Ihor Holovan, and Yuriy Kasyanov, and maintains a reader-supported membership model through its Club UP initiative.

## Key Topics

- Ukrainian politics
- War commentary and analysis
- EU integration
- Reform analysis
- Opinion journalism
- Mikhaylo Zhernakov
- Ihor Holovan
- Yuriy Kasyanov
- Veterans affairs
- Ukrainian economy
- Independent media
- Political commentary
- Democracy and governance
- Reader-supported journalism

## Opinion & Analysis

- [Blogs - Українська правда](http://blogs.pravda.com.ua/): Opinion blogs by Zhernakov, Holovan, Kasianov on Ukrainian politics & war
